messages:
Maria: Quick noteI opened a terraform PR to tighten Karpenter TTLs to save on idle costs. Provisioner snippet in the PR:

```
apiVersion: karpenter.sh/v1alpha5
kind: Provisioner
spec:
  ttlSecondsUntilExpired: 180
  ttlSecondsAfterEmpty: 30
  consolidation:
    enabled: true
```

Seeing some pods flip to Terminating and Pending on staging while HPAs are still adjusting. Expected nodes to stick around longer. Any immediate red flags with 30s afterEmpty?

Josh: 30s is very tight. If metrics bounce you can get eviction-reschedule loops. Recommend set afterEmpty to 300s initially. ttlSecondsUntilExpired=180 is aggressive but okay if you accept occasional evictions.

Samir: +1. Also add PDBs for critical frontends/backends so two replicas aren't evicted at once. For noisy metrics, increase HPA scaleDown stabilization window.

Kat: Example HPA we use to dampen scale-down noise (we use v2):

```
apiVersion: autoscaling/v2
kind: HorizontalPodAutoscaler
spec:
  behavior:
    scaleDown:
      stabilizationWindowSeconds: 240
      policies:
        - type: Percent
          value: 30
          periodSeconds: 60
```

That avoids immediate downscales which fight tight node TTLs.

Maria: Plan update: will change ttlSecondsAfterEmpty -> 300, keep ttlSecondsUntilExpired at 180 for now, add PDBs for web/api, and bump HPA stabilizationWindow to 240s. Anything else we should check (CA, node taints, spot behavior)?

Josh: If using spot instances, make sure node-termination-handler is deployed so pods get the interrupt notice. Also consider marking a small on-demand nodepool for critical pods so they don't get consolidated.

Samir: Note: don't run VPA and HPA on the same controllers unless you're using a VPA mode that only recommends and doesn't automatically update. VPA autoset can confuse HPA metrics.

Maria: Good catch. We're not enabling VPA for web. One more: does consolidation=true + low TTLs ever cause synchronized binpack-drains (i.e., multiple nodes reclaimed close together)?

Kat: Yes, consolidation will attempt to binpack and then remove nodes. With short afterEmpty it can amplify churn because consolidated nodes can become empty quickly. Keep consolidation=true but use longer afterEmpty or add a conservative consolidation window where possible.

Josh: Also scan the terraform diff for any changed annotations/taints that affect eviction grace or the daemonset responsible for graceful termination. We once lost a node annotation and pods were force-evicted with 0s grace.

ops-bot: CI note: running `terraform plan` and the k8s manifest linter on PR. Reminder to run `make staging-apply` during low-traffic window.

Maria: Thanks everyone. I'll update the PR (afterEmpty=300, add PDBs, HPA changes), run staging-apply in quiet hours, and ping for quick review. Tagging @Josh @Samir for early eyes.
